method: Local next dev of the worktree; Playwright Chromium and WebKit at DPR 2; /api/road-bearing stubbed with one two-way East Colfax Avenue candidate (Overpass unavailable 2026-10-25), everything else live. Pointer parked at the viewport's bottom-right corner before every measure and screenshot. Grounds are sampled from screenshot pixels 4 px inside the element's bottom-left corner (the rendered ground, not the computed style, since WebKit ignores the select's background); inks are computed styles (the check is var(--act) = rgb(52,169,232)). Contrast is WCAG 2.x relative luminance. Label centre x is the text node's client-rect centre minus the button/chip's left edge.
note: Playwright WebKit is not a real iPhone; iOS Safari is unchecked.
